50423569.title: Fun things to do with your VM/370 CE machine – Fun with big computers
50423569.title_zh: 使用 VM/370 社群版體驗大型主機樂趣
50423569.summary_zh: IBM 的 VM/370 社群版（VM/370 CE）是以開源與公有領域軟體大幅改進無授權限制大型主機作業系統的專案。開發者可透過 Docker 或 Podman 在個人電腦上快速部署並執行這套虛擬大型主機（virtual mainframe）系統。配合 x3270 終端機模擬器（terminal emulator），即可重溫 1960 年代基於表單互動的大型主機運作機制。
50423569.summary_en: IBM's VM/370 Community Edition (VM/370 CE) is a project that significantly enhances the un-licensed mainframe operating system using open-source and public domain software. Developers can quickly deploy and run this virtual mainframe system on personal computers using Docker or Podman. Paired with the x3270 terminal emulator, users can relive the form-based mainframe interaction mechanism of the 1960s.

50422168.title: Next-Concept Modeling: Fast, Parallel Coarse-to-Fine Text Generation
50422168.title_zh: Next-Concept Modeling：快速且平行的由粗到細文本生成技術
50422168.summary_zh: 研究人員提出名為 Next-Concept Modeling（NCM）的兩階段由粗到細（coarse-to-fine）生成架構，用以解決擴散語言模型（DLM）推論步驟多且效能遞減的問題。NCM 結合多尺度殘差向量量化自編碼器（VQ-VAE）與 Transformer，可在層級內平行預測離散代碼。實驗顯示，NCM 在多項評測標準上比最強的 DLM 基準模型快 10 至 31 倍，並在 Sudoku 推理任務中超越自迴歸（autoregressive）模型。
50422168.summary_en: Researchers proposed a two-stage coarse-to-fine generation framework called Next-Concept Modeling (NCM) to address the issue of diffusion language models (DLMs) requiring numerous inference steps with diminishing performance. NCM combines a multiscale residual vector quantized variational autoencoder (VQ-VAE) with a Transformer to predict discrete codes within each level in parallel. Experiments demonstrate that NCM runs 10 to 31 times faster than the strongest DLM baselines across multiple benchmarks and outperforms autoregressive models on Sudoku reasoning tasks.

50418176.title: KetchUp – Open-source SketchUp alternative built with Rust and WebGPU
50418176.title_zh: KetchUp：以 Rust 與 WebGPU 打造的開源 SketchUp 替代方案
50418176.summary_zh: BenchUp（前身為 KetchUp）是一款專為木工與家具設計打造的免費開源 3D 模型繪製軟體，支援桌面瀏覽器與主流作業系統。該工具採用 Rust 語言與 WebGPU 打造，提供類似 SketchUp 的推拉（Push/Pull）建模體驗與自動離線儲存功能。使用者能精確指定幾何尺寸，並可匯入 .skp 檔案或匯出 OBJ 格式以銜接後續的工作流程（workflow）。
50418176.summary_en: BenchUp (formerly KetchUp) is a free, open-source 3D modeling application designed for woodworking and furniture design, supporting desktop browsers and major operating systems. Built with Rust and WebGPU, the tool offers a SketchUp-like Push/Pull modeling experience with automated local saving capabilities. Users can specify precise geometric dimensions and import .skp files or export OBJ format to integrate with downstream workflows.

50419215.title: Unlocking any car from X brand in most of the world
50419215.title_zh: 遠端解鎖全球多數地區某知名品牌汽車的安全漏洞分析
50419215.summary_zh: 安全研究人員透過逆向工程解析某車廠車主 App 的 API 請求，發現其遙控車聯網（telematics）後台管理的測試工具存在嚴重資安漏洞。該後台管理介面直接暴露於網際網路，且多數 API 僅依賴前端 JavaScript 封包中硬編碼（hardcoded）的金鑰驗證身分。攻擊者只需藉由車牌號碼換取車輛識別碼（VIN），就能透過漏洞取得車主帳號權限並遠端解鎖車輛。
50419215.summary_en: Security researchers reverse-engineered the API requests of an automaker's owner app and uncovered severe security vulnerabilities in its backend telematics test tool. The administrative interface was directly exposed to the public internet, with most APIs relying solely on hardcoded keys in the front-end JavaScript bundle for authentication. Attackers could simply use a vehicle license plate number to obtain the vehicle identification number (VIN) and leverage the vulnerability to gain owner account access and remotely unlock vehicles.

50418975.title: I'm not convinced the AI bubble exists
50418975.title_zh: 為什麼我不認為人工智慧領域存在泡沫
50418975.summary_zh: 針對外界質疑人工智慧（AI）產業花費巨大且可能存在資產泡沫的觀點，分析指出目前數萬億美元的支出主要源自資料中心（data center）等一次性基礎設施建設。一旦資料中心竣工，營運成本將大幅下降，而現有營運資料顯示模型推算（compute）服務本身已有相當出色的獲利能力。此外，AI 公司亦可透過停止免費服務或暫緩高成本研發等方式快速調控支出，證明當前的高額估值與債務並非難以維持。
50418975.summary_en: In response to skepticism that the artificial intelligence (AI) industry is experiencing an unsustainable asset bubble due to massive spending, the analysis notes that current multi-trillion-dollar expenditures stem primarily from one-off infrastructure construction like data centers. Once data center construction is complete, operating costs will drop precipitously, while existing operational figures indicate that compute services themselves are already quite profitable. Furthermore, AI companies can rapidly control expenses by eliminating free tiers or pausing high-cost research, demonstrating that current valuations and debt levels are not inherently unsustainable.

50392256.title: Nvidia was in 1 in 11 startup rounds over $100M last year
50392256.title_zh: Nvidia 去年參與了近九成一億美元以上的巨額新創融資案
50392256.summary_zh: 數據顯示，Nvidia 及其創投部門 NVentures 在過去一年參與了全球 79 筆金額超過一億美元的超大型融資案，參與數量超越 Sequoia 與 Andreessen Horowitz 等頂級創投機構。在所有億級融資案中，有多達 38% 的案件包含企業策略投資人（corporate investor），其中 Nvidia 的參與頻率遠遠拋離其他科技巨頭。這反映出硬體晶片大廠透過資本手段深度佈局人工智慧（AI）生態系的影響力正在持續擴大。
50392256.summary_en: Data reveals that Nvidia and its venture arm NVentures participated in 79 mega-funding rounds exceeding $100 million over the past year, outstripping top traditional venture firms like Sequoia and Andreessen Horowitz. Corporate investors were present in 38% of all $100M+ rounds, with Nvidia's participation rate far pulling ahead of other tech giants. This underscores the expanding influence of hardware chipmakers strategically building out artificial intelligence (AI) ecosystems through capital investments.

50406107.title: Psalm 7 release: PHP security&static analysis software
50406107.title_zh: PHP 靜態分析與安全檢查工具 Psalm 7 正式發布
50406107.summary_zh: PHP 靜態分析工具 Psalm 迎來 7.0 版本更新，預設開啟安全性分析功能，並將效能提升超過十倍。新版本引入更深層的污染追蹤（taint tracking），能有效偵測 NoSQL 注入、大型語言模型（LLM）提示詞注入以及 URL 注入等安全漏洞。此外，Psalm 7 亦加入靈感來自 Hack 語言的純粹性模型（purity model）、基於圖論的廢程式碼檢測（dead code detection），並全面支援 PHP 8.5 與 8.6。
50406107.summary_en: The PHP static analysis tool Psalm released version 7.0, enabling security analysis by default and delivering over a 10x performance boost. The new release introduces deeper taint tracking that effectively detects security vulnerabilities such as NoSQL injection, large language model (LLM) prompt injection, and URL injection. Additionally, Psalm 7 adds a purity model inspired by the Hack language, graph-based dead code detection, and full support for PHP 8.5 and 8.6.

50368481.title: Declarative Dragging
50368481.title_zh: 宣告式拖曳：簡化圖形介面拖放互動的新開發架構
50368481.summary_zh: 榮獲 UIST 最佳論文獎的「宣告式拖曳（Declarative Dragging）」提案顛覆了傳統繪圖與拖放介面的開發模式。開發者無需撰寫複雜的幾何運算與動畫程式碼，只需宣告元件被拖曳後應到達的未來狀態，系統即可預先渲染並合成流暢的互動體驗。研究團隊發布了基於 Web SVG 的開源實作 Dragology，可應用於多維度數學探索工具與動態使用者介面（UI）設計。
50368481.summary_en: Awarded the UIST Best Paper, "Declarative Dragging" reimagines the development model for drawing and drag-and-drop interfaces. Instead of writing intricate geometry math and animation code, developers simply declare the future application states reachable by dragging an element, allowing the system to speculatively render and synthesize smooth interactions. The research team released Dragology, a Web SVG-based open-source implementation applicable to multi-dimensional math exploration tools and dynamic user interface (UI) design.

50422181.title: 370 Books in 20 months: South African author defends her use of AI
50422181.title_zh: 20 個月產出 370 本書：南非作者為自己使用 AI 寫作辯護
50422181.summary_zh: 南非作家 Coral Hart 在 20 個月內利用人工智慧（AI）創作並出版了超過 370 本書籍，銷售額已突破 100 萬美元。她整合了 ChatGPT、Claude 等多款大型語言模型（LLM）來規劃大綱與撰寫內文，最後再交由真人校對。儘管面臨網路上的大量批評與威脅，她仍強調 AI 寫作是不可逆的趨勢，且讀者最終會以購買行為來驗證作品品質。
50422181.summary_en: South African author Coral Hart has created and published more than 370 books using artificial intelligence (AI) in 20 months, with sales exceeding $1 million. She integrates multiple large language models (LLMs) such as ChatGPT and Claude to outline and write texts, which are then proofread by humans. Despite facing widespread online criticism and threats, she emphasizes that AI writing is an irreversible trend and readers ultimately validate book quality through their purchases.

50416158.title: Outlook.com is rejecting email from domains without DMARC
50416158.title_zh: Outlook.com 開始退回未設定 DMARC 網域的電子郵件
50416158.summary_zh: 微軟（Microsoft）旗下包含 Outlook.com 與 Hotmail 等電子郵件服務已開始退回未設定 DMARC 紀錄的網域所寄出的郵件。這項新政策並未提前公告，且同時影響發信量較低的普通企業與個人網域。網域管理者只需在 DNS 中新增一筆內容為 v=DMARC1; p=none 的 TXT 紀錄即可修復此問題。
50416158.summary_en: Microsoft email services, including Outlook.com and Hotmail, have begun rejecting emails sent from domains without DMARC records configured. This new policy was not announced in advance and affects ordinary business and personal domains with low sending volume alike. Domain administrators can resolve this issue simply by adding a TXT record with v=DMARC1; p=none to their DNS.

50416053.title: Dux: Free, open-source Wayland desktop shell with file manager and theming
50416053.title_zh: Dux：整合檔案管理器與主題功能的免費開源 Wayland 桌面外殼
50416053.summary_zh: Dux 是一款專為 Wayland 設計的免費開放原始碼（open-source）桌面外殼（desktop shell），提供流暢的介面動畫與動態主題配色。它內建了支援分頁與分欄的鍵盤優先檔案管理器、系統與程序監控工具，以及快速檔案搜尋能力。使用者可透過豐富的小工具（widget）自訂桌面體驗，並能自動替 GTK 與 Qt 應用程式搭配協調的主題配色。
50416053.summary_en: Dux is a free open-source desktop shell designed for Wayland, offering smooth interface animations and dynamic theme color generation. It features a built-in keyboard-first file manager supporting tabs and split views, system and process monitoring tools, and fast file search capabilities. Users can customize their desktop experience through rich widgets and automatically generate matching theme colors for GTK and Qt applications.

50421155.title: Show HN: Flide: Make Jev-like decision models up to 9.5x faster
50421155.title_zh: Show HN：Flide——將 Jev 類決策模型的推理速度提升最高 9.5 倍
50421155.summary_zh: Flide 是一套針對 Jev 架構決策模型設計的高效能推理（inference）基礎設施，支援精確狀態分叉（exact state forking）技術。與 vLLM 和 SGLang 等現有引擎相比，Flide 的推理速度最高可提升 9.5 倍，並提供相容的 API 介面。該專案已開放原始碼，並發布了研究論文與 PyPI 套件，支援 AutoTrust 與 KnowLine 等多種決策模型系列。
50421155.summary_en: Flide is a high-performance inference infrastructure designed for Jev-architecture decision models, supporting exact state forking technology. Compared to existing engines like vLLM and SGLang, Flide achieves up to 9.5 times faster inference speed while providing a compatible API interface. The project is open-source and has released a research paper and PyPI package, supporting multiple decision model families such as AutoTrust and KnowLine.

50422628.title: ChatGPT Desktop forwards your SSH agent to remote machines
50422628.title_zh: ChatGPT 桌面版會將你的 SSH Agent 轉發至遠端機器
50422628.summary_zh: 使用者發現 ChatGPT 桌面版應用程式會將本機的 SSH 代理程式（SSH agent）轉發至遠端機器。這意味著遠端執行的程式能夠使用本機的 SSH 憑證進行身份驗證，例如直接推送程式碼至使用者在 GitHub 上的私有儲存庫（repository）。此行為引發了社群關於安全性與憑證存取權限風險的廣泛討論。
50422628.summary_en: Users discovered that the ChatGPT Desktop application forwards the local SSH agent to remote machines. This means code running on the remote machine can authenticate using local SSH credentials, such as directly pushing code to the user's private repository on GitHub. This behavior has sparked widespread community discussion regarding security and credential access risks.

50373768.title: Quasi-Logarithmic Kitchen Timer
50373768.title_zh: 準對數刻度廚房計時器
50373768.summary_zh: 作者為了解決傳統計時器操作繁瑣與精度不足的問題，運用舊型微安培計電表（panel meter）自製一款具備準對數（quasi-logarithmic）刻度的廚房計時器。硬體採用 8 位元 AVR DB 系列微控制器（microcontroller）來驅動電表與音訊，並搭配旋轉編碼器（rotary encoder）及客製化楓木外殼。刻度設計分為四個線性區段，兼顧短時間精確調整與長時間範圍設定的需求。
50373768.summary_en: To solve the clunky operation and lack of precision in traditional timers, the author built a custom kitchen timer with a quasi-logarithmic scale using a vintage microammeter panel meter. The hardware utilizes an 8-bit AVR DB series microcontroller to drive the meter and audio, paired with a rotary encoder and a custom maple enclosure. The dial is divided into four linear sections to balance fine adjustments for short intervals with broad settings for longer durations.

50417407.title: Ask HN: What are you working on? (November 2026)
50417407.title_zh: Ask HN：你最近在忙什麼專案？（2026年11月）
50417407.summary_zh: 此為 Hacker News 的定期討論討論串，邀請社群成員分享自己近期正在開發的專案與感興趣的新技術。社群成員會在留言區交流各自的軟體工具、硬體實驗與技術探索心得。
50417407.summary_en: This is a recurring discussion thread on Hacker News inviting community members to share their recent projects and newly discovered interests. Community members exchange insights on their software tools, hardware experiments, and technical explorations in the comments section.

50418016.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's letter to staff about affair
50418016.title_zh: Nvidia 執行長黃仁勳針對外遇事件給員工的公開信
50418016.summary_zh: Nvidia 執行長（CEO）黃仁勳發出一封內部信件，公開承認對妻子不忠並向家人與全體員工致歉。信中強調會承擔全部責任，並表示將全力配合董事會針對媒體報導涉及國家安全（national security）疑慮所發起的獨立調查。
50418016.summary_en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang issued an internal letter publicly admitting to infidelity and apologizing to his family and all employees. In the letter, he stressed taking full responsibility and stated he will fully cooperate with the board's independent investigation regarding national security concerns raised in media reports.

50423371.title: Ask HN: Do you still enjoy coding in C++?
50423371.title_zh: Ask HN：你現在還喜歡寫 C++ 嗎？
50423371.summary_zh: 發問者發起討論，詢問社群成員是否仍享受使用 C++ 程式語言進行開發。儘管現代 C++ 引進了強型別系統（type system）、智慧指標（smart pointer）與範本（template）等便利特性，但複雜度過高與艱澀的範本編譯器（compiler）錯誤訊息也帶來許多挑戰。
50423371.summary_en: The poster initiated a discussion asking community members if they still enjoy developing with the C++ programming language. Although modern C++ introduced convenient features like a strict type system, smart pointers, and templates, its excessive complexity and obscure compiler error messages involving templates still pose significant challenges.

50404428.title: Ur-Nammu Founder of the Sumerian Renaissance
50404428.title_zh: 烏爾納姆：蘇美文藝復興的開創者
50404428.summary_zh: 介紹美索不達米亞歷史人物烏爾納姆（Ur-Nammu），他創立了烏爾第三王朝並開啟蘇美文藝復興時期。他頒布了世界上現存最古老的法律條文《烏爾納姆法典》（Code of Ur-Nammu），並下令興建烏爾大神廟（Great Ziggurat of Ur），推動文化發展與基礎建設。
50404428.summary_en: This piece introduces the Mesopotamian historical figure Ur-Nammu, who founded the Third Dynasty of Ur and initiated the Sumerian Renaissance. He promulgated the world's oldest surviving legal code, the Code of Ur-Nammu, commissioned the Great Ziggurat of Ur, and promoted cultural development and infrastructure.

50411961.title: Llama-modchip: 284B DeepSeek on 64GB RAM, no GPU
50411961.title_zh: Llama-modchip：無需 GPU 在 64GB 記憶體執行 284B DeepSeek 模型
50411961.summary_zh: 開放原始碼（open-source）專案 llama-modchip 透過修改 llama.cpp 的核心與量化（quantization）轉碼器，讓混合專家模型（MoE）能在純 CPU 與系統記憶體（RAM）上運作。該工具採用自訂的 2 位元量化與快取優化演算法，成功將 2840 億參數的 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 壓縮並載入至 64GB 記憶體的機器中，避免產生 Swap 交換空間。此外還整合單指令多資料流（SIMD）核心修補與自測機猜測解碼（speculative drafting），顯著提升提示預填（prefill）與解碼速度。
50411961.summary_en: The open-source project llama-modchip modifies llama.cpp kernels and quantization transcoders to run Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models purely on CPUs and system RAM. Using custom 2-bit quantization and cache optimization algorithms, the tool successfully compresses and loads the 284B-parameter DeepSeek-V4-Flash into a 64GB RAM machine without triggering swap. Additionally, it integrates SIMD kernel patches and self-speculative drafting to significantly accelerate prompt prefill and decoding speeds.

50416363.title: How I Fight AI Brain Fry
50416363.title_zh: 我如何應對 AI 造成的腦袋焦糊
50416363.summary_zh: 作者分享如何解決頻繁切換 AI 輔助程式設計工具多個對話視窗所導致的認知過載（cognitive overload）與注意力分散問題。他將工作流程轉化為基於 Git 版本控制系統的優先權佇列（priority queue），將每個任務儲存為 Markdown 檔案並交由代理人（agent）處理。自己則只需透過單一介面審查結果與下達決策，每次完成一個任務即關閉上下文，藉此維持專注力。
50416363.summary_en: The author shares how to tackle cognitive overload and context switching caused by managing multiple AI coding agent tabs simultaneously. He converted his workflow into a Git-based priority queue where each task is stored as a Markdown file and processed by an agent. He then only needs to review results and make decisions via a single view artifact, closing the context after each task to maintain focus.

50415628.title: Goldman Sachs is pulling Claude Code from its bankers and traders
50415628.title_zh: 高盛限制交易員與銀行家使用 Claude Code AI 工具
50415628.summary_zh: 高盛（Goldman Sachs）更新內部規範，限制 Anthropic 的 Claude Code 與微軟（Microsoft）的 GitHub 程式碼工具僅供工程師使用，禁止交易員與銀行家繼續使用。此舉源於對生產力與資訊安全風險的評估，因為非技術人員使用能寫入並執行程式碼的 AI 代理人（agent）可能帶來合規與資料隱私疑慮。儘管高盛正擔任 Anthropic 的首次公開發行（IPO）主承銷商，銀行仍基於權限控制與防火牆要求實施了角色限制。
50415628.summary_en: Goldman Sachs updated its internal guidance to restrict Anthropic's Claude Code and Microsoft's GitHub coding tools strictly to engineers, prohibiting traders and bankers from using them. The move stems from productivity and cybersecurity risk evaluations, as non-technical staff using AI agents capable of writing and executing code raised compliance and data privacy concerns. Despite Goldman Sachs acting as a lead underwriter for Anthropic's IPO, the bank enforced role-based restrictions due to permission control and information barrier requirements.

50412067.title: Writing as a thinking tool
50412067.title_zh: 將寫作作為思考的工具
50412067.summary_zh: 作者探討了將寫作視為思考擴充工具的觀點，並引用計算理論說明缺乏寫作輔助的人腦如同有限狀態自動機（Finite Automata），而結合寫作後則具備圖靈機（Turing Machine）的強大運算能力。透過將思考外部化至紙張或文字上，創作者能更好地釐清複雜概念並激發新想法。即使在大型語言模型（LLM）盛行的時代，個人獨特的直覺與創意跳躍依然需要透過親手寫作來梳理。
50412067.summary_en: The author explores the perspective of using writing as an extension tool for thinking, citing computation theory to explain that the human brain without writing is like a finite automaton, but gains the power of a Turing machine when combined with writing. By externalizing thoughts onto paper or text, creators can better clarify complex concepts and spark new ideas. Even in the era of Large Language Models (LLMs), an individual's unique intuition and creative leaps still require personal writing to be articulated.

50420035.title: RIP, Harvest
50420035.summary_zh: 作者分享了他使用了十年的時間追蹤與請款服務 Harvest 在被收購後品質惡化的過程。收購公司將方案大幅漲價、加收額外交易手續費，並以大型語言模型（LLM）取代了原本的人工客戶服務。這導致該軟體的實用性大幅降低，迫使自由工作者開始尋求其他替代方案。
50420035.summary_en: The author shares the deteriorating quality of Harvest, a time-tracking and invoicing service used for a decade, following its corporate acquisition. The acquiring company drastically raised plan prices, added extra transaction fees, and replaced human customer service with Large Language Models (LLMs). This significantly diminished the software's utility, forcing freelancers to seek alternative solutions.

50423662.title: Electric cars are about to overtake petrol in the UK, data shows
50423662.title_zh: 數據顯示英國純電動車銷量即將超越汽油車
50423662.summary_zh: 根據英國汽車製造商和貿易商協會（SMMT）的最新數據，純電動車（BEV）在英國新車市場的比率已升至 32%，與降至 37.2% 的汽油車差距大幅縮小。按照目前成長趨勢與年底銷售高峰預估，電動車銷量最快可能在今年 12 月或不久後超越汽油車。然而，這波成長主要由中國電動車品牌推動，傳統車廠則持續呼籲政府放寬零排放車輛強制令（ZEV Mandate）的目標。
50423662.summary_en: According to recent data from the Society of Motor Manufacturers and Traders (SMMT), battery electric vehicles (BEVs) reached a 32% share of the UK new car market, significantly closing the gap with petrol cars, which dropped to 37.2%. Based on current growth trends and end-of-year sales spikes, EV sales could overtake petrol cars as early as this December or shortly thereafter. However, this growth is largely driven by Chinese EV brands, prompting traditional automakers to urge the government to relax Zero Emission Vehicle (ZEV) mandate targets.

50420857.title: A Critique of GPUI
50420857.summary_zh: 作者針對以 Rust 開發的桌面使用者介面（UI）框架 GPUI 與 egui 提出批判，認為它們的狀態模型難以承載複雜的應用程式。文章分析指出，GPUI 採用的粗粒度通知機制類似於 zone.js，每次狀態變更都會引發大規模重新渲染，導致效能隨 UI 規模擴大而下滑。作者主張，結合訊號（signal）與響應式更新的架構才是打造高效能原生桌面軟體的最佳選擇。
50420857.summary_en: The author presents a critique of GPUI and egui, desktop user interface (UI) frameworks developed in Rust, arguing that their state models struggle to support complex applications. The article analyzes how GPUI's coarse-grained notification mechanism resembles zone.js, where each state change triggers widespread re-renders, causing performance to degrade as the UI scales. The author contends that an architecture combining signals and reactive updates is the best choice for building high-performance native desktop software.

50401844.title: Show HN: JavaScript web apps with WASM layout and GPU rendering in 280 KB
50401844.title_zh: Show HN：大小僅 280 KB、整合 WASM 排版與 GPU 渲染的 JavaScript Web 應用程式框架
50401844.summary_zh: Uniform 是一個輕量化的使用者介面（UI）框架，壓縮後大小不足 280 KB，能替代原生 UI 工具鏈來建置跨平台應用程式。它採用 C 語言編寫的核心並編譯為 WebAssembly（WASM）來執行高效率排版，並透過 WebGPU 與 Metal 進行顯示卡硬體加速渲染。該框架還支援有符號距離場（SDF）圖形渲染與低延遲輸入處理，讓設計師能精確控制像素與動畫效果。
50401844.summary_en: Uniform is a lightweight user interface (UI) framework under 280 KB compressed that can replace native UI toolchains for building cross-platform applications. It utilizes a C-written core compiled to WebAssembly (WASM) for efficient layout processing, paired with WebGPU and Metal for hardware-accelerated rendering. The framework also supports Signed Distance Field (SDF) shape rendering and low-latency input processing, giving designers precise control over pixel layouts and animation effects.
